title.en: Dialogue 1: Moving to a new city
title.ur: Mukaalma 1: Naye shehar mein muntaqil hona

intro.en: Rashid asks Nabil why he moved from Amman to Aqaba and how he likes his new city. Notice the question words لِماذا (why), كَيْفَ (how), كَمْ (how long) and إِلى أَيْنَ (to where).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Rashid, Nabil se poochta hai ke woh Amman se Aqaba kyun muntaqil hua aur use naya shehar kaisa lagta hai. Sawali alfaaz dhyan se dekhein: لِماذا (kyun), كَيْفَ (kaise), كَمْ (kitna) aur إِلى أَيْنَ (kahan ki taraf).
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ رَشيدٌ نَبيلًا: لِماذا اِنْتَقَلْتَ مِنْ عَمّانَ إِلى العَقَبَةِ؟ وَكَيْفَ تَجِدُ المَدينَةَ الجَديدَةَ؟ تَعَلَّمْ أَدَواتِ الاسْتِفْهامِ: لِماذا، كَيْفَ، كَمْ، إِلى أَيْنَ.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا اِنْتَقَلْتَ مِنْ عَمّانَ يا نَبيلُ؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā intaqalta min ʿAmmān yā Nabīl?
dialogue.en: Why did you move from Amman, Nabil?
dialogue.ur: Nabeel, aap Amman se kyun muntaqil hue?

dialogue.ar: أَبي مُديرُ الشَّرِكَةِ، وَقَدِ اِنْتَقَلْنا مَعَهُ إِلى العَقَبَةِ.
dialogue.tr: abī mudīru sh-sharika, wa qadi ntaqalnā maʿahu ilā l-ʿAqaba
dialogue.en: My father is the company manager, and we moved with him to Aqaba.
dialogue.ur: Mere walid company ke manager hain, aur hum unke saath Aqaba muntaqil ho gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ كُنْتَ سَعيداً هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal kunta saʿīdan hunāk?
dialogue.en: And were you happy there?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aap wahan khush the?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَصْدِقائي في عَمّانَ كَثيرونَ، وَلَكِنَّ العَقَبَةَ جَميلَةٌ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, aṣdiqāʾī fī ʿAmmāna kathīrūn, wa lākinna l-ʿAqabata jamīlatun ayḍan
dialogue.en: Yes, I have many friends in Amman, but Aqaba is beautiful too.
dialogue.ur: Haan, Amman mein mere bohat dost hain, lekin Aqaba bhi khoobsurat hai.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تَجِدُ هَذِهِ المَدينَةَ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa tajidu hādhihi l-madīna?
dialogue.en: How do you find this city?
dialogue.ur: Aapko yeh shehar kaisa lagta hai?

dialogue.ar: المَدينَةُ صَغيرَةٌ، وَالبَحْرُ قَريبٌ مِنْ بَيْتِنا.
dialogue.tr: al-madīnatu ṣaghīra, wa l-baḥru qarībun min baytinā
dialogue.en: The city is small, and the sea is near our house.
dialogue.ur: Shehar chhota hai, aur samundar hamare ghar ke qareeb hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَقْضي وَقْتَكَ بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa kayfa taqḍī waqtaka baʿda l-madrasa?
dialogue.en: And how do you spend your time after school?
dialogue.ur: Aur school ke baad aap apna waqt kaise guzarte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَلْعَبُ مَعَ أَصْدِقائي الجُدُدِ عَلى الشّاطِئِ.
dialogue.tr: alʿabu maʿa aṣdiqāʾī l-jududi ʿalā sh-shāṭiʾ
dialogue.en: I play with my new friends on the beach.
dialogue.ur: Main apne naye doston ke saath saahil par khelta hoon.

dialogue.ar: إِلى أَيِّ مَدينَةٍ تُسافِرونَ في العُطْلَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: ilā ayyi madīnatin tusāfirūna fī l-ʿuṭla?
dialogue.en: To which city do you travel in the holiday?
dialogue.ur: Aap log chhutti mein kis shehar ka safar karte hain?

dialogue.ar: نَذْهَبُ إِلى مَكَّةَ لِأَداءِ العُمْرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: nadhhabu ilā Makka li-adāʾi l-ʿumra
dialogue.en: We go to Makkah to perform Umrah.
dialogue.ur: Hum Umrah ada karne Makkah jaate hain.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: kam sāʿatan tastaghriqu r-riḥla?
dialogue.en: How many hours does the trip take?
dialogue.ur: Safar mein kitne ghante lagte hain?

dialogue.ar: تَسْتَغْرِقُ عَشْرَ ساعاتٍ تَقْريباً، وَنَرْتاحُ في الطَّريقِ.
dialogue.tr: tastaghriqu ʿashra sāʿātin taqrīban, wa nartāḥu fī ṭ-ṭarīq
dialogue.en: It takes about ten hours, and we rest on the way.
dialogue.ur: Takreeban das ghante lagte hain, aur hum raaste mein aaraam karte hain.

options: His father's company moved to Aqaba / Walid ki company Aqaba muntaqil hui
He was unhappy / Woh naakhush tha
He wanted to study / Woh parhna chahta tha
He had no friends / Uska koi dost nahi tha
options_ar: لِأَنَّ شَرِكَةَ أَبيهِ اِنْتَقَلَتْ إِلى العَقَبَةِ

q.ur: "Shehar" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَكانًا كَبيرًا يَسْكُنُهُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ؟

q.en: Where does Nabil's family go for Umrah?
q.ur: Nabeel ka khandaan Umrah ke liye kahan jata hai?
q.ar: إِلى أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ أُسْرَةُ نَبيلٍ لِأَداءِ العُمْرَةِ؟

q.en: How long does the trip to Makkah take?
q.ur: Makkah ka safar kitni der leta hai?

options: About ten hours / Takreeban das ghante

intro.en: Fahd asks his new professor, Idris, where he came from, when, and why. Notice حَضَرْتُ (I came) and the answer «حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ» (I came to study).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Fahd apne naye ustaad Idris se poochta hai ke woh kahan se, kab aur kyun aaye. Dhyan dein حَضَرْتُ (main aaya) aur jawab «حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ» (main parhne aaya).
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ فَهْدٌ أُسْتاذَهُ إِدْريسَ: مِنْ أَيِّ بَلَدٍ حَضَرْتَ؟ وَمَتى؟ وَلِماذا؟ لاحِظْ كَلِمَةَ «حَضَرْتُ» وَالجَوابَ «حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ».

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَيِّ بَلَدٍ حَضَرْتَ يا أُسْتاذُ؟
dialogue.tr: min ayyi baladin ḥaḍarta yā ustādh?
dialogue.en: Which country did you come from, professor?
dialogue.ur: Ustaad, aap kis mulk se aaye?

dialogue.ar: حَضَرْتُ مِنَ المَغْرِبِ، وَجِنْسِيَّتي مَغْرِبِيَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍartu mina l-Maghrib, wa jinsiyyatī maghribiyya
dialogue.en: I came from Morocco, and my nationality is Moroccan.
dialogue.ur: Main Maghrib (Morocco) se aaya, aur meri qaumiyat Maghribi hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمَتى حَضَرْتَ إِلى هُنا؟
dialogue.tr: wa matā ḥaḍarta ilā hunā?
dialogue.en: And when did you come here?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap yahan kab aaye?

dialogue.ar: حَضَرْتُ قَبْلَ سِتِّ سَنَواتٍ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍartu qabla sitti sanawāt
dialogue.en: I came six years ago.
dialogue.ur: Main chhe saal pehle aaya.

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا حَضَرْتَ إِلى هُنا؟
dialogue.tr: wa limādhā ḥaḍarta ilā hunā?
dialogue.en: And why did you come here?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap yahan kyun aaye?

dialogue.ar: حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ، ثُمَّ عَمِلْتُ أُسْتاذاً في الجامِعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍartu lid-dirāsa, thumma ʿamiltu ustādhan fī l-jāmiʿa
dialogue.en: I came to study, and then I worked as a professor at the university.
dialogue.ur: Main parhne aaya, phir university mein ustaad ban gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ تَزَوَّجْتَ هُنا؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal tazawwajta hunā?
dialogue.en: And did you get married here?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aapne yahan shaadi ki?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، تَزَوَّجْتُ بَعْدَ الدِّراسَةِ، وَزَوْجَتي يَمَنِيَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, tazawwajtu baʿda d-dirāsa, wa zawjatī yamaniyya
dialogue.en: Yes, I got married after my studies, and my wife is Yemeni.
dialogue.ur: Haan, maine parhai ke baad shaadi ki, aur meri biwi Yamani hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ جَوازُ سَفَرِكَ مَغْرِبِيٌّ؟
dialogue.tr: hal jawāzu safarika maghribī?
dialogue.en: Do you have a Moroccan passport?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapke paas Maghribi passport hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، وَأَزورُ المَغْرِبَ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wa azūru l-Maghriba kulla sana
dialogue.en: Yes, and I visit Morocco every year.
dialogue.ur: Haan, aur main har saal Maghrib jata hoon.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ أَهْلُكَ هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal ahluka hunāk?
dialogue.en: Is your family there?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapke ghar waale wahan hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أُمّي وَأَبي يَسْكُنانِ هُناكَ، فَأَزورُهُما في العُطْلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, ummī wa abī yaskunāni hunāk, fa-azūruhumā fī l-ʿuṭla
dialogue.en: Yes, my mother and father live there, so I visit them in the holiday.
dialogue.ur: Haan, meri ammi aur abbu wahan rehte hain, to main chhutti mein unse milne jata hoon.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ أَنْتَ سَعيدٌ في هَذِهِ المَدينَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal anta saʿīdun fī hādhihi l-madīna?
dialogue.en: Are you happy in this city?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap is shehar mein khush hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لي أَصْدِقاءُ طَيِّبونَ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wa l-ḥamdu lillāh, lī aṣdiqāʾu ṭayyibūn
dialogue.en: Yes, praise be to Allah, I have good friends.
dialogue.ur: Haan, alhamdulillah, mere achhe dost hain.

q.en: Where did Professor Idris come from?

options: For a trip / Sair ke liye

title.ur: Mukaalma 3: Shehar ki zindagi, gaon ki zindagi

intro.en: Yasir asks Mazen about his city home and his grandfather's village. Learn words about the village (هادِئ, نَقِيّ) and the city (ضَوْضاء, تَلَوُّث, اِزْدِحام).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Yasir, Mazen se uske shehar ke ghar aur dada ke gaon ke bare mein poochta hai. Gaon ke alfaaz (هادِئ, نَقِيّ) aur shehar ke alfaaz (ضَوْضاء, تَلَوُّث, اِزْدِحام) seekhein.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ ياسِرٌ مازِنًا عَنْ بَيْتِهِ في المَدينَةِ وَقَرْيَةِ جَدِّهِ. تَعَلَّمْ كَلِماتِ القَرْيَةِ (هادِئ، نَقِيّ) وَكَلِماتِ المَدينَةِ (ضَوْضاء، تَلَوُّث، اِزْدِحام).

dialogue.ar: في أَيِّ مَكانٍ بَيْتُكُمْ يا مازِنُ؟
dialogue.tr: fī ayyi makānin baytukum yā Māzin?
dialogue.en: Where is your house, Mazen?
dialogue.ur: Mazen, aapka ghar kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: بَيْتُنا في المَدينَةِ، وَبَيْتُ جَدّي في قَرْيَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: baytunā fī l-madīna, wa baytu jaddī fī qaryatin ṣaghīra
dialogue.en: Our house is in the city, and my grandfather's house is in a small village.
dialogue.ur: Hamara ghar shehar mein hai, aur mere dada ka ghar ek chhote gaon mein hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ هِيَ القَرْيَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: wa kayfa hiya l-qarya?
dialogue.en: And how is the village?
dialogue.ur: Aur gaon kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: هَواءُ القَرْيَةِ نَقِيٌّ، وَالنّاسُ هُناكَ هادِئونَ.
dialogue.tr: hawāʾu l-qaryati naqiyy, wa n-nāsu hunāka hādiʾūn
dialogue.en: The village air is clean, and the people there are calm.
dialogue.ur: Gaon ki hawa saaf hai, aur wahan ke log pur-sukoon hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ تُحِبُّ المَدينَةَ أَيْضاً؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal tuḥibbu l-madīnata ayḍan?
dialogue.en: And do you like the city too?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aapko shehar bhi pasand hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، فيها شَرِكاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ وَأَسْواقٌ كَبيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, fīhā sharikātun kathīra wa aswāqun kabīra
dialogue.en: Yes, it has many companies and big markets.
dialogue.ur: Haan, wahan bohat si companyan aur bade bazaar hain.

dialogue.ar: أَلَيْسَ في المَدينَةِ مُشْكِلَةٌ؟
dialogue.tr: a-laysa fī l-madīnati mushkila?
dialogue.en: Isn't there a problem in the city?
dialogue.ur: Kya shehar mein koi masla nahi?

dialogue.ar: بَلى، فيها اِزْدِحامٌ كَبيرٌ في الصَّباحِ، وَضَوْضاءُ وَتَلَوُّثٌ.
dialogue.tr: balā, fīhā izdiḥāmun kabīrun fiṣ-ṣabāḥ, wa ḍawḍāʾu wa talawwuth
dialogue.en: Yes, it has heavy traffic in the morning, and noise and pollution.
dialogue.ur: Haan, wahan subah bohat bheer hoti hai, aur shor aur aaloodgi bhi hai.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تَذْهَبُ إِلى مَدْرَسَتِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa tadhhabu ilā madrasatika?
dialogue.en: How do you go to your school?
dialogue.ur: Aap apne school kaise jaate hain?

dialogue.ar: أَذْهَبُ بِالقِطارِ كُلَّ صَباحٍ.
dialogue.tr: adhhabu bil-qiṭāri kulla ṣabāḥ
dialogue.en: I go by train every morning.
dialogue.ur: Main har subah train se jata hoon.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ مِنَ الوَقْتِ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: kam mina l-waqti tastaghriqu r-riḥla?
dialogue.en: How much time does the trip take?
dialogue.ur: Safar mein kitna waqt lagta hai?

dialogue.ar: نِصْفَ ساعَةٍ فَقَطْ، وَلا مُشْكِلَةَ عِنْدي.
dialogue.tr: niṣfa sāʿatin faqaṭ, wa lā mushkilata ʿindī
dialogue.en: Only half an hour, and I have no problem.
dialogue.ur: Sirf aadha ghanta, aur mujhe koi masla nahi.

q.en: How does Mazen describe the village air?
q.ur: Mazen gaon ki hawa ko kaisa batata hai?

options: Full of noise / Shor se bhara

q.ur: "Aloodgi" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى أَنَّ الهَواءَ غَيْرُ نَظيفٍ؟

q.en: How does Mazen go to school?

q.ur: "Bheed / traffic" ke liye kaun sa lafz?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني كَثْرَةَ السَّيّاراتِ وَالنّاسِ في المَدينَةِ؟

intro.en: Match each word with its plural: صَديق → أَصْدِقاء, شَرِكَة → شَرِكات, طِفْل → أَطْفال. Then match words with places: the village is quiet, the city has pollution and noise.
intro.ur: Har lafz ko uski jama se milayein: صَديق → أَصْدِقاء, شَرِكَة → شَرِكات, طِفْل → أَطْفال. Phir alfaaz ko jagah se milayein: gaon pur-sukoon hai, shehar mein aloodgi aur shor hai.
intro.ar: طابِقْ بَيْنَ كُلِّ كَلِمَةٍ وَجَمْعِها: صَديق ← أَصْدِقاء، شَرِكَة ← شَرِكات، طِفْل ← أَطْفال. ثُمَّ اخْتَرِ الكَلِماتِ المُناسِبَةَ لِلْقَرْيَةِ وَلِلْمَدينَةِ.

q.en: Which word belongs to the village?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz gaon se milta hai?

intro.en: Practise asking and answering with a friend: مَتى حَضَرْتَ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟ – حَضَرْتُ قَبْلَ عَشْرِ سَنَواتٍ. Also كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟ – تَسْتَغْرِقُ ساعَةً واحِدَةً. Use لِماذا تَرَكْتَ…؟ and أَذْهَبُ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى…
intro.ur: Dost ke saath sawal jawab ki mashq karein: مَتى حَضَرْتَ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟ – حَضَرْتُ قَبْلَ عَشْرِ سَنَواتٍ. Aur كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟ – تَسْتَغْرِقُ ساعَةً واحِدَةً. Saath hi لِماذا تَرَكْتَ…؟ aur أَذْهَبُ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى… istemal karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ مَعَ صَديقِكَ: مَتى حَضَرْتَ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟ – حَضَرْتُ قَبْلَ عَشْرِ سَنَواتٍ. وَكَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟ – تَسْتَغْرِقُ ساعَةً واحِدَةً. وَاسْتَعْمِلْ: لِماذا تَرَكْتَ…؟ وَأَذْهَبُ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى…

q.en: How do you ask "When did you come from Yemen?"
q.ur: "Aap Yaman se kab aaye?" kaise poochenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ وَقْتِ الحُضورِ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟

options: I came ten years ago / Main das saal pehle aaya
I will come in ten years / Main das saal baad aaunga
I stayed ten days / Main das din raha
I left ten years ago / Main das saal pehle gaya

q.en: Which question asks about the duration of a trip?
q.ur: Safar ki muddat kaun sa sawal poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ مُدَّةِ الرِّحْلَةِ؟

q.en: Answer: كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ إِلى مَكَّةَ؟
q.ur: Jawab dein: كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ إِلى مَكَّةَ؟
q.ar: أَجِبْ: كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ إِلى مَكَّةَ؟

intro.en: Practise the sound ث (th), made with the tongue between the teeth. Listen and repeat the names: ثابِت، حارِث، لَيْث، ثامِر. Then do the listening drills.
intro.ur: Harf ث (th) ki awaz ki mashq karein, zubaan daanton ke beech rakh kar. Sunein aur naam dohrayein: ثابِت، حارِث، لَيْث، ثامِر. Phir sun kar samajhne ki mashqein karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى صَوْتِ حَرْفِ الثّاءِ (ث) وَيَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ طَرَفِ اللِّسانِ وَالأَسْنانِ. اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرِ الأَسْماءَ: ثابِت، حارِث، لَيْث، ثامِر. ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ تَمارينِ الاسْتِماعِ.

q.ur: Kaun sa naam ث se shuru hota hai?
Kis naam ke aakhir mein ث hai?

q.en: Which name has ث in the middle?
q.ur: Kis naam ke beech mein ث hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ فيهِ حَرْفُ الثّاءِ بَعْدَ الرّاءِ؟

options: حارِث (before the last letter / aakhri harf se pehle)

q.en: Which name has no ث at all?
q.ur: Kis naam mein ث bilkul nahi?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ لَيْسَ فيهِ حَرْفُ الثّاءِ؟

intro.en: Answer questions about the family trip to Makkah: Who is in the car? Where is the family going? What will they do? Then practise dialogues like «مِنْ أَيْنَ حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ مِنَ اليَمَنِ.» and «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ لِلْعَمَلِ / لِلدِّراسَةِ / لِلْعُمْرَةِ / لِلْحَجِّ.»
intro.ur: Makkah ke khandani safar ke bare mein sawalon ke jawab dein: gaari mein kaun hai? Ghar wale kahan ja rahe hain? Phir «مِنْ أَيْنَ حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ مِنَ اليَمَنِ.» aur «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ لِلْعَمَلِ / لِلدِّراسَةِ / لِلْعُمْرَةِ / لِلْحَجِّ.» jaise mukalmon ki mashq karein.
intro.ar: أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ حَوْلَ رِحْلَةِ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى مَكَّةَ: مَنْ في السَّيّارَةِ؟ إِلى أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ الأُسْرَةُ؟ ماذا سَتَفْعَلُ؟ ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ عَلى حِواراتٍ مِثْلِ «مِنْ أَيْنَ حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ مِنَ اليَمَنِ.» وَ«لِماذا حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ لِلْعَمَلِ / لِلدِّراسَةِ / لِلْعُمْرَةِ / لِلْحَجِّ.»

options: I came for Umrah / Main Umrah ke liye aaya
I came for work / Main kaam ke liye aaya
I came for study / Main parhne aaya
I came from Umrah / Main Umrah se aaya

q.ur: Mukammal karein: حَضَرْتُ ____ العَمَلِ (kaam ke liye)
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ بِما يَدُلُّ عَلى السَّبَبِ: حَضَرْتُ ____ العَمَلِ

options: Where is the family? / Ghar wale kahan hain?
Who is the family? / Ghar wale kaun hain?
Is the family happy? / Kya ghar wale khush hain?
How is the family? / Ghar wale kaise hain?
Whether the family is happy / Ghar wale khush hain ya nahi
The family's age / Ghar walon ki umar
The family's work / Ghar walon ka kaam
The family's food / Ghar walon ka khana

intro.en: Read the paragraph about Thabit in Jeddah, then answer yes or no. Read another paragraph about Abdul Aziz, a Kenyan student in Makkah, and answer the questions.
intro.ur: Thabit ke bare mein paragraph parhein jo Jeddah mein rehta hai, phir haan ya nahi mein jawab dein. Phir Abdul Aziz ke bare mein paragraph parhein, jo Kenya ka talib-e-ilm hai aur Makkah mein parhta hai, aur sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ فِقْرَةً عَنْ ثابِتٍ في جُدَّةَ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ بِـ«نَعَمْ» أَوْ «لا». ثُمَّ اقْرَأْ فِقْرَةً أُخْرى عَنْ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ، طالِبٍ كِينيٍّ في مَكَّةَ، وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

options: In Umm al-Qura University in Makkah / Makkah ki Jamia Umm al-Qura mein
options_ar: في جامِعَةِ أُمِّ القُرى في مَكَّةَ

q.ur: Abdul Aziz ki qaumiyat kya hai?

q.en: Where does Abdul Aziz pray Asr, Maghrib and Isha?
q.ur: Abdul Aziz Asr, Maghrib aur Isha kahan parhta hai?
q.ar: أَيْنَ يُصَلّي عَبْدُ العَزيزِ العَصْرَ وَالمَغْرِبَ وَالعِشاءَ؟

options: Arabic language and Islamic culture / Arabi zubaan aur Islami saqafat

intro.en: Join letters to make words, put scrambled letters and words in order, fill the blanks, and copy the plurals: شَرِكات، جامِعات، مُسْتَشْفَيات. Finish with colours and plural words.
intro.ur: Haroof jorr kar lafz banayein, bikhre hue haroof aur alfaaz ko tarteeb dein, khali jagahein bharein aur jama alfaaz naqal karein: شَرِكات، جامِعات، مُسْتَشْفَيات. Aakhir mein rang aur jama alfaaz ki dohrai karein.
intro.ar: صِلِ الحُروفَ لِتُكَوِّنَ كَلِماتٍ، وَرَتِّبِ الحُروفَ وَالكَلِماتِ المُبَعْثَرَةَ، وَأَكْمِلِ الفَراغاتِ، وَانْسَخِ الجُموعَ: شَرِكات، جامِعات، مُسْتَشْفَيات. ثُمَّ راجِعِ الأَلْوانَ وَالجُموعَ.

q.en: Choose the right word: أَذْهَبُ إِلى شاطِئِ ____
q.ur: Sahi lafz chunein: أَذْهَبُ إِلى شاطِئِ ____
q.ar: اخْتَرِ الكَلِمَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ: أَذْهَبُ إِلى شاطِئِ ____

q.ur: "Mahine" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
